notes:
### New Features
- **Navidrome support** - Connect a Navidrome (Subsonic) server in Settings → Sources and browse its artists, albums and playlists live, without importing anything
- **Source switcher** - A dropdown in the sidebar header switches between your local library and the server catalog; server pages use the same layout as local ones
- **Download manager** - Grab single tracks, whole albums or playlists from the server, watch progress in the new Downloads panel, cancel or retry jobs. The queue is persistent and survives an app restart
- **Offline copies** - A downloaded track keeps its audio as a separate copy: remove the copy and the track stays in your library, streaming again. Storage settings show how much space copies take and can clear them
- **Server tracks in your library** - Like a server track, add it to a playlist or download it, and it joins your library together with its album and artist. "Remove from library" takes it back out without losing listening history
- **Search across sources** - Search covers the library, the server and YouTube; YouTube search now runs while you type instead of waiting for Enter
- **History for server tracks** - Playback history and listening stats now count tracks played from the server
- **Import prompt for opened files** - An audio file opened with the app can be imported into the library in one click
- **Save as...** - Export a local file or an offline copy to any folder

### Improvements
- Streams and covers go through a local proxy, so server credentials stay out of media URLs, DevTools and logs
- The next track in the queue is prefetched; switching tracks over the network starts faster
- Covers are cached in memory and no longer flicker when lists re-render; server covers in the sidebar start as a small blurred preview and swap to the full image once it loads
- YouTube downloads moved to the shared download manager
- The compact sidebar got tooltips with the entity name and type, and a playing indicator on the active entry
- The sidebar header animates the search field and the back button; header menus close when the cursor leaves them
- Deleting tracks, albums or artists is now a single transaction; a crash mid-delete can no longer leave half-removed data
- Imports run one at a time, so parallel imports no longer create duplicate artists
- Empty states across panels share one component

### Bug Fixes
- Playing something from the server catalog no longer adds its album and artist to your local lists and search
- "Download" and "Add to library" work for server tracks reached through browsing and search
- Downloaded server albums and artists show up correctly when adding items to folders
- The play button on album cards of a server artist page works
- Context menus on server artist and playlist pages no longer open empty
- The cover of the playing server album shows in the player panels
- Renaming a playlist while one of its tracks is being deleted no longer loses the rename
- The sidebar no longer flashes a scrollbar on reload
